items.statement: Notify FDA of every change to any condition set out in the approved NDA that goes beyond the variations the NDA already allows, unless a written request for a labeling exception or alternative has been submitted and granted for it.
items.quote: Except as provided in paragraph (a)(1)(ii) of this section, the applicant must notify FDA about each change in each condition established in an approved NDA beyond the variations already provided for in the NDA.
items.condition: change beyond variations provided for in the approved NDA; unless a granted exception or alternative request applies

items.statement: Do not distribute drug product made using a moderate change if, within 30 days after FDA receives the supplement, FDA tells the applicant that the change needs approval before distribution or that required supplement information is missing.
items.quote: The applicant must not distribute the drug product made using the change if within 30 days following FDA's receipt of the supplement, FDA informs the applicant that either:
items.condition: FDA informs the applicant within 30 days of receipt of the supplement
